query:
INSERT INTO region_units (kind, parent_id, name, sort_order, number, head_name,
             head_phone)
             SELECT $1, $2, $3, CASE WHEN $1 = 'hamlet'::region_kind
                 THEN coalesce(max(sort_order), 0) + 1 END, $4, $5, $6
             FROM region_units WHERE kind = 'hamlet'
             RETURNING id
